items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I made a lot of albums with Dizzy because he didn't have any set big band, of course. And I made quite a few albums with his band.

ctx.x: Yes, I think you were. And we made "Emaline" , another tune like that. And I made some records -- well, I made a lot of albums with Dizzy because he didn't have any set big band, of course. And I made quite a few albums with his band. And in the '40s I got to make a record with Louis Armstrong, who was always my big idol. "Fish Market Blues" with Roy Eldridge, that record. I even made an album with Charlie Parker. They had a big band, all the strings and everything.
